working_definition: Adult VNC cells of the authors' type hemilineages 20A/22A (Allen et al. 2020, Figure 1-source data 2), 5-day-old adults.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Secondary neuron belonging to a hemilineage that has active Notch signaling.

justification: The authors could not separate hemilineages 20A and 22A; both are Notch ON hemilineages: their common class.
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00049541 Notch ON hemilineage secondary neuron (broad match).
